title: Generation of Photonic Graph States with minimal number of quantum emitters
summary: Graph states are a fundamental resource for measurement and fusion-based quantum computing, quantum networks, and sensing. Preparing them in a photonic system deterministically is, in principle, possible, but finding efficient schemes to prepare them was a long-standing problem addressed recently. Additionally, heuristic optimization schemes for reducing the required number of two-qubit gates were developed.
